title: git-test-repositories lists git checkout and git worktree add as always running die_if_checked_out, though --ignore-other-worktrees and --force skip it
goal: kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md's 'In use is wider' fact says git checkout/switch skip die_if_checked_out under --ignore-other-worktrees and git worktree add under --force, citing git v2.55.0 builtin/checkout.c and builtin/worktree.c

run: import re,sys;t=open('kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md',encoding='utf-8').read();p=[x for x in re.split(r'\n(?=- )',t) if x.startswith('- "In use" is wider')];sys.exit(0 if p and '--ignore-other-worktrees' in p[0] and '--force' in p[0] else 1)

repro_reason: the gap is one fact's wording in a kb article; no code path prints it
notes: Verified 2026-10-14 on ae319c43c5 by a read-only Sonnet verifier against the source read raw: REAL. git v2.55.0 builtin/checkout.c:1647 returns before die_if_checked_out under ignore_other_worktrees (also when the main HEAD symref already names the branch, :1650-1652); builtin/worktree.c:487 calls it only if !opts->force (and :870 for -B); builtin/rebase.c:1704 calls it unconditionally. git-test-repositories.md:261-268 lists them all with no skip. builtin/checkout.c and builtin/worktree.c have no source row: two CODE rows at v2.55.0 in kb/public/_sources.csv and the article header. Repro now also requires --force.
